name: parameter-uq
title: Parameter UQ — global sensitivity of v2ecoli
lead:
A whole-cell model has thousands of parameters; which of them actually matter
is usually argued from intuition. This investigation answers it empirically.
One forward-UQ method — sample a prior, fit a polynomial-chaos surrogate, read
Sobol indices analytically — is applied across an escalating parameter surface,
and at every stage it returns a single dominant lever, not a diffuse blur:
ribosome elongation rate for growth, dry-mass fraction for mass, and (turning
the same lens from diagnosis to design) expression strength for a
heterologous product's yield. The payoff is a reusable capability: point the
method at any knob surface — endogenous physiology or an engineered strain —
and get back a ranked, interaction-aware attribution instead of a guess.

at_a_glance.role: Screens 7 config-reachable knobs to the 3 that move growth rate (>2% response), excluding 4 inert ones, defining the effective UQ surface for studies 01–03.
Finds basal_elongation_rate dominates growth-rate variance (Sobol ≈ 0.97) among effective elongation knobs, after fixing the carryover bug (PR #197).
basal_elongation_rate dominance holds for mass observables (dry_mass/cell_mass Sobol ~0.86) over a 360-step window; the growth-rate ranking is window-dependent (kS overtakes basal by 360 steps).

EVALUATED (preliminary): θ-binned (birth→division, 10 bins) cell-cycle-stratified Sobol over the 3 elongation knobs, full multi-generation lineage. Finds sensitivity is STAGE-DEPENDENT with a HANDOFF near θ≈0.5 — basal_elongation_rate dominates the EARLY cycle (peak 0.78 at θ≈0.15), kS (ppGpp/charging saturation) takes over MID-LATE (peak 0.58 at θ≈0.65). Stage-dependence test PASSES (across-stage Sobol range 0.47 ≫ 0.1). Refines param-uq-01/02's flat 'elongation dominates'. Magnitudes preliminary (decoy leaks at n=24; handoff is above noise). Enabled by the division config_overrides fix (v2ecoli#505).

RAN: extends UQ to deep SimulationDataEcoli physiological params via a sim_data injection adapter. Finds the dry-mass fraction dominates mass variance (Sobol ≈ 1.0) and co-dominates growth (≈0.5, with RNAP elongation rate); FBA kinetic weight inert. Establishes a cheap (~2 s/sample) deep-param injection path — the pivot's ~2.5-min-ParCa premise was wrong.

EVALUATED (gate passed) — all 3 aggregation strategies delivered on a resolving n=24 ensemble (3 seeds, 2 gens, 168 records). Turns the pbg-uq machinery on a STRAIN-DESIGN use case (GFP new-gene, expression + translation-efficiency knobs). EXPRESSION dominates product level (Sobol ≈0.73 vs trl_eff 0.37), argmax-robust across all seeds and both generations — CONFIRMS 'expression dominates'. Adversarial-null PASSES (inert decoy 0.02 < 0.05; test err 61%→23%), and the by-generation ranking is generation-invariant. A rigor win: the honest adversarial gate caught and reversed an under-resolved n=12 reading (which had trl_eff leading + a spurious generational trend). Growth-rate not assertable (light GFP load). The parameter-uq deliverable absorbing the standalone uqEcoli demo.

glossary.definition: Uncertainty quantification that propagates input-parameter uncertainty forward to output variance (as opposed to inverse/parameter inference). Here it ranks which sim_data knobs drive variance in single-cell observables.
A variance-based global-sensitivity measure giving the fraction of output variance attributable to a parameter including all its interactions. A total-order near 0.97 means one knob dominates.
A surrogate representing model output as an orthogonal-polynomial series in the uncertain inputs, from which Sobol indices are read off analytically instead of by expensive Monte Carlo.
The sampling scheme used to build the PCE surrogate; multiple PCRV seeds check that the sensitivity ranking is stable rather than a sampling artifact.
The ribosome translation-elongation-rate parameter this study identifies as the dominant driver of instantaneous growth-rate variance.
The large calibrated parameter object produced by the ParCa that configures the whole-cell model; its many fields are the parameter space this investigation screens.

How a multi-cell, multi-generation ensemble is pooled before its output variance is attributed. Strategy 1 (population) bulk-averages all cells and timepoints; strategy 2 (by-generation) stratifies by cell generation; strategy 3 (by-seed) stratifies by stochastic lineage seed. The same ensemble can yield different Sobol rankings under each, so the choice is reported, not assumed.

A heterologous gene (here GFP) inserted at ParCa build time (new_genes: gfp) and induced via the new_gene_internal_shift variant. Its expression and translation-efficiency factors are the "design knobs" param-uq-05 sweeps — turning the sensitivity method into a strain-engineering tool.

biological_story:
Translation is one of the cell's largest energy sinks, so which elongation dial
most shapes growth rate is a natural question. Forward uncertainty
quantification — run after fixing a state-carryover bug that had faked the
original signal and switching to instantaneous growth rate as the observable —
finds that the ribosome's basal elongation rate dominates, about 97% of the
growth-rate variance among these knobs, far above ppGpp synthesis or the
DNA-polymerase rate. This follows from mechanism: basal_elongation_rate sets how
fast ribosomes add amino acids, which sets the protein-synthesis flux that drives
growth. The first result (GTP cost dominates) was an artifact; the finding held
up only after independent samples, effective parameters, a responsive observable,
and an adequate budget were in place.

The investigation then widens the parameter surface. Going deeper than the
config-reachable knobs, a sim_data injection adapter reaches the calibrated
physiological parameters and finds the dry-mass fraction dominates MASS variance
almost entirely, co-dominating growth with the RNAP elongation rate — so the
dominant lever depends on both the observable and how deep into sim_data you
reach. Two lessons carry forward: sensitivity is a property of an
(observable, parameter-surface, time-window) triple, not of a parameter alone;
and the pbg-uq machinery is cheap enough (~seconds per deep-param sample) to
sweep that surface systematically.

Finally the same method turns from diagnosis to design. A heterologous GFP gene
is inserted and induced, and its two engineering dials — how strongly it is
transcribed (expression) and how efficiently its message is translated
(translation efficiency) — are swept to ask which one a strain engineer should
turn to move product yield, and at what cost to growth. Because the gene is
induced at a chosen generation, the answer is examined three ways from a single
ensemble — averaged over the whole population, split by generation across the
induction, and split by stochastic seed — so the aggregation choice becomes part
of the finding rather than a hidden assumption. This is the strain-design study
(param-uq-05). A first n=12 smoke was deliberately under-resolved — its inert
decoy leaked, flagging the fit as untrustworthy — so the study was scaled to a
resolving ensemble: n=24, 3 seeds, 2 generations, 168 records. At that budget
the adversarial-null check PASSES (the inert decoy falls to ≈0.02, product test
error to ≈23%), and a clear, robust answer emerges: EXPRESSION dominates
product-level variance (total-order Sobol ≈ 0.73 vs translation efficiency ≈
0.37 under population aggregation), and it wins in every seed and both
generations. This CONFIRMS the pre-registered "expression dominates" hypothesis.
Two things are worth noting. First, the by-generation decomposition is
generation-invariant here (expression dominant in both, ≈0.72 → 0.75) — the
smoke's apparent "expression early, translation late" trend was an artifact of
the under-resolved fit, and the adversarial-null gate is exactly what caught it
before it could be reported. Second, growth-rate variance is too small (a light
GFP load) to attribute — no growth ranking is claimed. The lesson the elongation
study taught — sensitivity is trustworthy only after independent samples, a
responsive observable, and an adequate budget — held again: the honest gate
reversed a premature reading and delivered the resolved one.

A last question sharpens the whole diagnosis: is the elongation-rate dominance
a fixed property of the cell, or does it move as the cell ages? Running the
sweep across a full birth→division cycle and binning by cell-cycle progress θ
(param-uq-03) shows it MOVES: the ribosome's elongation rate dominates the early
cycle (Sobol peaks ~0.78 just after birth), then near mid-cycle (θ≈0.5) the
dominant lever HANDS OFF to kS — the ppGpp/charging saturation constant that
couples elongation to the amino-acid supply (peaks ~0.58 late-cycle). So "which
knob matters" is not one answer but two, split by when in the cell cycle you
ask: biosynthetic throughput early, its metabolic regulation late. The handoff
sits well above the noise band; the absolute magnitudes are still preliminary
(the growth signal's total variance is modest, so the inert-decoy control leaks
at this budget — a heavier ensemble is the noted follow-up). This became
measurable only once the Division step was fixed to carry a perturbation into
the daughter (v2ecoli#505); before that, generation ≥2 silently reverted.
question:
Which sim_data parameters drive variance in v2ecoli single-cell observables?
Starting with the ribosome-elongation subsystem, forward uncertainty
quantification (PCRV-sampled PCE surrogate + analytic Sobol indices) identifies
which elongation knobs most control mass/growth variance, setting a template for
a systematic global-sensitivity sweep across the full parameter space. The same
method then generalizes along two axes: from endogenous physiology to
ENGINEERED DESIGN knobs (a heterologous GFP new-gene strain, param-uq-05), and
from a single bulk statistic to a decomposition across AGGREGATION STRATEGIES
(population / by-generation / by-seed) — turning the diagnostic sweep into a
design tool and a methodological demonstration for the M8/08.4.2 UQ milestone.
hypothesis:
Among ribosome-elongation parameters, the energetic cost of elongation
(gtpPerElongation) — not raw elongation speed — is the dominant lever on
single-cell mass/growth, because GTP availability couples translation to the
cell's energy budget. Forward UQ should surface a single dominant driver
(total-order Sobol ≥ 0.5) rather than a diffuse, evenly-shared sensitivity.

executive.what_is_this: Forward global-sensitivity UQ (pbg-uq) finding which sim_data parameters drive variance in the v2ecoli baseline. A low/high screen kept the 3 knobs that move growth rate; PCE forward UQ ran over 120- and 360-step windows; the deep physiological params were swept via a sim_data injection adapter (param-uq-04). The investigation now extends to a STRAIN-DESIGN use case (param-uq-05): a GFP new-gene insert swept via expression + translation-efficiency knobs, delivering the M8/08.4.2 milestone's required aggregation-strategy-1–3 (population / by-generation / by-seed) decomposition natively in v2ecoli — the deliverable that supersedes the standalone uqEcoli demo.
executive.verdict:
One forward-UQ method (PCRV → PCE surrogate → analytic Sobol), applied across
an escalating parameter surface, returns a single dominant lever at every
stage rather than a diffuse blur:
• GROWTH (config knobs): the ribosome's translation basal_elongation_rate
  dominates instantaneous-growth-rate variance — total-order Sobol ≈ 0.97,
  stable across 3 PCRV seeds, ~1.7% surrogate error (param-uq-01). The
  original "GTP cost dominates (0.88)" reading was a state-carryover artifact
  (v2ecoli PR #197); gtpPerElongation / ribosomeElongationRate are inert.
• …but that dominance is STAGE-DEPENDENT (param-uq-03): across the cell cycle
  it hands off near θ≈0.5 — elongation rate leads early (Sobol ~0.78), kS
  (ppGpp/charging saturation) leads late (~0.58). Handoff robust; magnitudes
  preliminary.
• MASS (deep sim_data): the dry-mass fraction dominates mass variance almost
  entirely (Sobol ≈ 1.0), co-dominating growth with the RNAP elongation rate
  (param-uq-04).
• DESIGN (GFP strain): the same method ranks engineering knobs — expression
  dominates new-gene product level (Sobol ≈ 0.73 vs translation efficiency
  0.37), robust across seeds and generations, adversarial-null passed at n=24
  (param-uq-05). This confirms the pre-registered hypothesis and reversed an
  under-resolved n=12 reading the honest gate caught.
Net: sensitivity is a property of an (observable, parameter-surface,
cell-cycle-stage) triple, and the method generalizes from diagnosis to design.

decisions_needed.question: Fund the resolving follow-up ensembles (param-uq-03 and the strain-design decoy) to firm the preliminary magnitudes?
decisions_needed.context:
All six member studies have now run. Two carry PRELIMINARY magnitudes whose
RANKINGS are robust but whose absolute Sobol values (and single-seed argmax)
are not yet converged: param-uq-03's cell-cycle handoff (inert decoy leaks at
n=24; recommended n≥48/≥3 seeds/steps≈5100 for a full gen-2 cycle) and the
strain-design growth-rate axis. The qualitative findings (elongation early /
kS late handoff; expression dominates product) stand; only the magnitude
precision is open. Decide whether the demonstration is sufficient or the
firming runs are worth the compute.

decisions_needed.question: Accept that growth-rate sensitivity is not assertable for the GFP strain, or design a heavier-load strain?
decisions_needed.context:
Across every budget the GFP metabolic load is too light to move growth-rate
variance above the surrogate noise floor (decoy ≈ growth signal), so no
growth-rate knob ranking is claimed. A higher-burden construct would be
needed to attribute growth cost — out of scope for the demonstration, noted
as the honest boundary of the product-level finding.

decisions_resolved.question: Expand to the DEEP sim_data physiological parameters (ParCa-level injection)?
decisions_resolved.resolution:
Built a sim_data injection adapter (pbg_v2ecoli.uq_sim_data_injection) that
routes each deep param either POST_PARCA (it surfaces as a runtime config key →
config_overrides, no rebuild) or REBUILD (it shapes initial_state → regenerate
the bundle with save_sim_input). Two premises of the original block were wrong:
the "rebuild" is a ~2 s bundle regeneration (no full ParCa refit, not ~2.5 min),
and several deep params (RNAP elongation rate, FBA weights) are reachable with
NO rebuild at all. Result: the dry-mass fraction (a deep param reachable only
via the rebuild path) dominates mass variance (total-order Sobol ≈ 1.0) and
co-dominates growth rate (≈0.5, shared with RNAP elongation rate); the FBA
kinetic-objective weight is inert. The deep physiological surface is now cheaply
sweepable; the open follow-up is to widen to the full uqEcoli deep-param set over
multi-generation runs and re-calibrate bounds to v2ecoli's current ParCa state.

scientific_argument.main_claim:
Among effective config-reachable elongation knobs, basal_elongation_rate
dominates instantaneous-growth-rate variance (Sobol ≈ 0.97).
evidence_for: Total-order Sobol of basal_elongation_rate = 0.966 (range 0.955–0.987 across 3 PCRV seeds); dominant knob identical every seed (argmax [0,0,0]).
First-order ≈ total (0.956 vs 0.966): the effect is direct, with little interaction.
PCE surrogate test relative error 1.3–2.1% supports the variance attribution.
Mechanistically expected: basal_elongation_rate sets ribosome speed → protein synthesis → growth rate.
evidence_against: Scope (now partly addressed by param-uq-04): studies 00–02 varied only config-reachable top-level knobs. param-uq-04 added a sim_data injection adapter and tested 3 deep physiological params — finding the dry-mass fraction dominates MASS variance (Sobol ≈ 1.0) and co-dominates growth with the elongation rate. So the dominant lever depends on the observable and the parameter surface; a full deep-param sweep is still open.
Observable is instantaneous growth rate over a 120-step window (~4% of a generation); mass observables don't respond at this window, and longer windows could shift weights.
key_figures: param-uq-05-strain-design/charts/investigation_arc_dominant_driver.png — CAPSTONE: the method's dominant lever at each stage (elongation-rate→growth 0.97, dry-mass→mass 1.0, expression→product 0.73) — the diagnosis→design arc in one figure.
charts/sobol_indices.png — Sobol bars (across-seed whiskers): basal_elongation_rate ≈ 0.97 dominant.
charts/pce_response_curves.png — growth rate rises with basal_elongation_rate; flat vs kS and DNA-pol rate.

param-uq-05-strain-design/charts/sobol_by_strategy.png — strain-design Sobol under all three aggregation strategies (n=24); expression dominates product level in every strategy, generation-invariant, with the inert decoy pinned under the null band (adversarial-null passes).
caveats: This corrects an earlier artifact; the original demo's 'GTP-dominant 0.88' was a carryover bug (v2ecoli PR #197), and 2 of its 3 params were inert.

The proven core (main_claim) is the elongation/deep-param DIAGNOSIS on the baseline. The strain-design generalization (param-uq-05: design knobs + aggregation strategies 1–3) is DESIGNED and wired but NOT yet run — it carries no result and does not back any claim here until the GFP-ParCa build + ensemble complete.

studies.name: param-uq-00-screen
studies.title: Parameter screen — which config-reachable knobs actually drive the observables?
studies.question:
Among the top-level `ecoli-*` process-config scalars, which actually change the
growth observables when perturbed (so they're worth including in the UQ)?
studies.claim:
Of the top-level process-config knobs reachable via `baseline()` config_overrides,
only 3 produce a real change in growth rate; the rest are inert.

studies.name: param-uq-01-elongation
studies.title: Ribosome basal elongation rate dominates growth-rate variance among effective elongation knobs (Sobol ≈ 0.97)
studies.question:
(1) Does the pbg-uq forward-UQ pipeline run end-to-end on v2ecoli? (2) Among the
elongation parameters that actually affect the simulation, which dominates
variance in instantaneous growth rate — and is the ranking robust across seeds?
studies.claim:
Among the v2ecoli elongation knobs reachable via baseline config_overrides, the
ribosome's translation basal_elongation_rate ROBUSTLY DOMINATES variance in
instantaneous growth rate — total-order Sobol ≈ 0.97 (stable across 3 PCRV
seeds, range 0.955–0.987), vs ppGpp-synthesis kS ≈ 0.04 and DNA-pol elongation
rate ≈ 0.01. The PCE surrogate fits to ~1.7% test error. This CORRECTS the
initial demo, whose "gtpPerElongation dominates (0.88)" reading was a
state-carryover artifact (fixed in v2ecoli PR #197).

studies.name: param-uq-02-observables
studies.title: Multi-observable robustness — basal_elongation_rate dominates MASS; growth-rate ranking is window-dependent
studies.question:
Over a longer (360-step) window, do dry_mass and cell_mass become responsive to
the 3 effective elongation knobs, does basal_elongation_rate remain dominant
across observables, and is the ranking stable to the choice of observable/window?
studies.claim:
Over a longer (360-step) window the MASS observables become responsive, and
basal_elongation_rate DOMINATES them — total-order Sobol ≈ 0.86 for both
dry_mass and cell_mass — confirming and extending the param-uq-01 finding to
mass. For instantaneous growth rate, however, the ranking is WINDOW-DEPENDENT:
ppGpp-synthesis kS edges basal_elongation_rate at 360 steps (0.62 vs 0.51), vs
basal's 0.97 at 120 steps. So the dominant driver of growth-rate variance shifts
with the integration window — a genuine nuance on top of the headline result.
